name: yxj-paper-os
description: Reader-first, evidence-bound paper revision with durable author directions, recurrence repair, impact closure, and canonical artifact verification.

interface.shortDescription: Reader-first revision that closes repeated feedback.
interface.longDescription: YXJ Paper OS is a returning paper revision authority with a non-negotiable evidence boundary. It resolves repository-declared authority, re-enters by material delta, preserves stable author directions, diagnoses repeated findings before another edit, applies explicit revisions across every affected surface, and proves the canonical rendered artifact matches the current source without rewriting shared Git history.
capabilities: Explicit assess, design, revise, and audit intent
Reader-first problem, claim, contribution, and story design
Non-negotiable scientific evidence boundary with minimal sufficient defense
Stable author directions and recurrence root-cause repair
Direct writeback with cross-surface impact closure
interface.defaultPrompt: Use YXJ Paper OS as the paper revision authority. Resolve repository-declared authority and the current material delta first. Preserve active stable author directions. If a finding recurs, compare the prior diff, acceptance criterion, source, and artifact, then repair the root cause rather than repeat a local wording patch. Keep every claim within all claim-relevant evidence, serve the reader first, apply only explicitly authorized edits across every affected surface, rebuild and identify the canonical artifact, use fixed cold-reader tasks for global story changes when available, and report impact closure.
